title: HelloWorld: Towards Practical Applications of Generative Driving World Models

output_modality.value: synchronized seven-camera RGB video, plus RGB-conditioned LiDAR synthesis (range and intensity)

control_signal.value: 6-DoF ego pose, rendered HD maps and 3D boxes, text, camera identity, optionally first-frame image.

control_mechanism.value: Factorized conditioning: ego pose via Plucker raymap encoder modulating backbone by adaptive normalization; HD map and 3D box layout via control tower injecting residuals at multiple depths; text via cross-attention; learned camera embedding.

base_model.value: 2B block-causal multi-view DiT with rectified-flow objective in latent space of a causal video VAE; progressive training from general video; distilled from 20-step teacher to 4-step student; pretrained video-VAE architecture adapted for LiDAR.

datasets.value: Heterogeneous general and fleet video; single-view benchmark uses DL3DV, Sekai, SpatialVid, RealEstate10K, OmniWorld plus 40 real-world driving clips. Multi-view training data not detailed in packet.

metrics.value: Pose rotation and translation error (Sim(3) aligned, metric-scale in m), VBench dimensions, cross-camera Sampson error (CSE), LiDAR range and Chamfer metrics.

controllability_evidence.value: Pose adherence: 29-frame benchmark rotation 2.0620 and translation 0.2570 versus Lingbot World 2.0 at 3.2310 and 0.2853; versus Cosmos transfer 2.5, rotation 5.534 to 2.027 degrees, translation 1.880 to 1.352.

closed_loop.value: Yes, demonstrated qualitatively: coupled with the Alpamayo 1.5 action model in an observation-action loop using the few-step student; rollout length not stated in packet. Paper says it is not a validated closed-loop simulator.

stated_limitations.value: Ego trajectories are prescribed, no policy feedback or reactive traffic; some control-tower paths use bidirectional attention; bounded KV cache gives no persistent scene memory; conflicting conditions (text truncated).

notes: Packet is partial; Cosmos comparison numbers are for the post-trained model with first-frame conditioning. Limitations list is cut off at text and pose.
